b2b_hero_h1: Stop profit leakage. Turn casual guests into regulars in half a second.
b2b_hero_sub_new: Next-gen loyalty system without apps, forms, and spam. Zero Friction technology that works to ensure recurrence.
b2b_leaky_bucket_h2: Why your current loyalty system doesn't work 100%?
b2b_leaky_bucket_intro: Why do you lose up to 83% of new guests? Classic programs are hopelessly outdated. They don't work because people hate to wait. And you lose money.
b2b_problem_app_desc: 80% of guests refuse to download a new app or fill out long forms at checkout.
b2b_problem_stanford_desc: Stanford scientists proved: if an action requires effort (high friction), the customer won't do it, no matter how valuable the reward.
b2b_problem_blindspot_desc: Paper stamp cards know nothing about your guests. You can't know who stopped visiting until it's too late.
b2b_leaky_bucket_fact: Important fact: acquiring a new customer costs 7 times more than retaining an existing one. Your budget goes into a "leaky bucket" if the customer doesn't return.
b2b_simplicity_intro: We removed all barriers between you and your customer.
b2b_simplicity_tap: Tap & Go: The guest simply taps their phone on an NFC tag or scans a QR code.
b2b_simplicity_recognize: Instant Recognition: The device is recognized in the browser. No SMS codes or registrations.
b2b_simplicity_done: Done: The customer is now in your database, and you've achieved 100% conversion to the loyalty program.
b2b_science_intro: Ordinary programs force people to collect points for months boringly. We used an approach based on behavioral economics.
b2b_science_nobel_desc: People fear losing what they have twice as much as they desire to gain something new (Loss Aversion).
b2b_science_melting_desc: The guest receives status upfront. But if they delay their next visit (e.g., for more than 14 days), the discount starts to "melt."
b2b_science_result_desc: Customers return not just for the discount, but to maintain their VIP status. We create a habit of enjoyable returns exclusively for you.
b2b_ai_h2: Own your audience completely. AI-powered precision marketing.
b2b_ai_intro: Mass SMS messages no longer work — the brain classifies them as spam. REVOO automatically collects your customer base and segments them into: new, regular, and lost.
b2b_ai_cocktail_desc: AI suggests targeted messages based on guest behavior. "We miss you" for lost customers, and "Special treat" for regulars.
b2b_ai_pareto_desc: Our analytics show you the 20% of guests who generate 80% of your profits. Invest in the right people.
b2b_usecase_sports_desc: Fill empty slots in your schedule by bringing back players.
b2b_usecase_clinic_desc: Recoup the system cost by bringing back one high-value client.
b2b_usecase_resto_desc: Increase the visit frequency of regular guests.
b2b_usecase_beauty_desc: Remind them of you on the day they need a haircut refresh.
b2b_final_h2: Dare to be the best. With zero financial risk.
b2b_final_sub: We implement the system in 48 hours without disrupting your operations.
b2b_final_guarantee: If we don't document an increase in customer return rates within 30 days, we'll refund your full cost.
b2b_form_received: We have received your request and will contact you within 24 hours.

b2c_hero_sub: We created the technology of reciprocity. Stop being just a "table number". Your loyalty to the venue always comes back to you in the form of real privileges and care.
